items.title: Complete write with no elision
Literal protocol tag inside written content must be escaped
Model must not emit forbidden paths (.., absolute)
Multiple writes in one message, correct ordering and prose
Closing tag must be at line start (even when content contains tags)
Exact SEARCH with sufficient surrounding context
Insufficient context leads to ambiguous or failed match (model must add more)
Multi-block edit where later blocks depend on earlier results
Model provides exact text; ws-normalized fallback is only a safety net
File not shown in context — model must not guess contents
Rename a file and update all imports in the same turn
Delete a file that is confirmed unused
Copy a template file then customize it with edit
Delete on a non-existent path produces FILE_NOT_FOUND (model should not emit it)
Rename that would break imports — model fixes in same turn or notes the risk
Add multiple dependencies in one tag — they are batched
Dependencies installed before a workflow run in the same turn
Unknown workflow name produces UNKNOWN_WORKFLOW (model must use only declared ones)
Long-running workflow (dev) must be emitted last even if it reads naturally earlier
Remove a dependency that is no longer used
Good plan-mode output with concrete, executable steps
Trivial change in plan mode — model proposes direct execution instead of padding a plan
Plan mode + any other action tag is a hard violation (negative test)
Vague steps are penalized; concrete naming is required
Plan names files and approaches that match project conventions
EDIT_NO_MATCH — model must re-read the excerpt and use exact text or switch to write
Unknown workflow — model switches to a declared one on feedback
PATH_FORBIDDEN — model narrows scope to the visible project root on recovery
Validator warning on TODO stub — model removes the placeholder before finishing the turn or in immediate follow-up
No lengthy apologies; no repeating a failed edit; concise ack + smallest fix

notes: All items are original text written to probe specific sentences and tables in packages/protocol/SPEC.md §4 and packages/knowledge/prompts/engine-prompts.md. No source code from the project is embedded in the corpus items.
